name: ConnectCue
author: Vynatics

sections.description:
ConnectCue displays polished online, offline and connection-checking notifications without aggressive AJAX polling.

Highlights:

  • Event-driven browser connectivity detection.
  • Optional rate-limited REST health checks.
  • Dependency-free public JavaScript.
  • Scoped frontend CSS and namespaced PHP.
  • Accessible ARIA live status notifications.
  • Responsive positioning, animation, skins and color controls.
  • Commercial-grade dashboard, settings and diagnostics.
  • Settings migration from the previous 2.x release and earlier 1.x releases.
  • Multisite-aware activation and uninstall behavior.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate ConnectCue.
  3. Open ConnectCue > Settings.
  4. Configure the notification and save changes.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin continuously call my server?

No. Native browser online/offline events are used by default. Optional health checks are disabled by default and enforce a minimum 15-second interval.

Does it require jQuery?

No. The frontend and dashboard scripts use dependency-free JavaScript.

What versions are supported?

Version 2.1.2 requires WordPress 6.4 or newer and PHP 8.0 or newer. Compatibility with WordPress 7.1 should be verified on a staging installation before production use.

Are old settings retained?

Yes. Existing settings from the previous WP Connection Detector Pro 2.x plugin, or the original 1.x release, are imported on activation if ConnectCue has no saved settings. Deactivate the old plugin before activating ConnectCue.
sections.changelog:
2.1.2 – 2026-11-23

  • Fixed translation domain and plugin directory slug mismatch with WordPress.org.
  • Restricted uninstall cleanup to ConnectCue-owned settings only.
  • Validated inline CSS colors and numeric values for existing and migrated settings.
  • Hardened SVG rendering and admin preview output; guarded legacy migration against unrelated generic options.
  • Improved settings cleanup description and runtime consistency.

2.1.1 – 2026-10-24

  • Updated readme compatibility metadata and removed the unsupported main-file Tested up to header.
  • Added translator notes for placeholder strings.
  • Prepared a submission-specific package matching its WordPress.org slug.

2.1.0 – 2026-08-11

  • Rebranded as ConnectCue with a new text domain, namespace, CSS and JavaScript identifiers, REST endpoint and storage keys.
  • Added automatic import of previous 2.x settings where present.
  • Redesigned the frontend toaster with a premium status-driven visual system, refined spacing, shadows and responsive behavior.
  • Added polished built-in SVG icons for online, offline and checking states.
  • Added secure per-state custom inline SVG icon settings with automatic fallback to built-in icons.
  • Upgraded the dismiss control with a dedicated close icon, hover/focus states and preserved status-change reappearance behavior.
  • Updated the dashboard preview to reflect the new toaster design and configured icons.
  • Fixed centered slide-left and slide-right hidden-state transforms.

2.0.0 – 2026-08-06

  • Rebuilt the plugin architecture for PHP 8.0+.
  • Tested for WordPress 7.0.x compatibility.
  • Replaced 100ms AJAX polling with browser events and optional rate-limited health checks.
  • Added a premium dashboard, settings interface, live preview and system diagnostics.
  • Added strict sanitization, validation, capability checks and output escaping.
  • Added scoped CSS, unique handles and dependency-free JavaScript to reduce conflicts.
  • Added accessibility and reduced-motion support.
  • Added multisite-aware activation, migration and uninstall handling.
  • Fixed legacy nonce and uninstall defects.

1.0.0 – 2021-12-25

  • Initial release.
